Hi I'm Maxime, an AI researcher working in Singapore (Genome Institute of Singapore). Before that, I obtained a masters in computer science from KU Leuven (you can find my thesis [here](./docs/thesis.pdf)).

My interests in machine learning lie mainly in non-supervised approaches (self-supervised / reinforcement learning). Currently, I primarily work on foundation models for genomics (DNA & RNA).

I am open to PhD opportunities (starting in September 2027) so please do not hesitate to [contact me](https://mrochk.github.io/contact.html).
